title: Will Trump Start World War 3? with Ben Rhodes
summary: Comedy interview with Ben Rhodes arguing Trump's foreign policy follows US tradition; covers the 2026 Iran war, the Hormuz closure and the risk of today's wars merging into a world war.

assertions.quote: Then we have Russia and China as like an axis, let's call it that. Um cooperating.
The North Koreans have sent troops to fight in Ukraine like so that bring the North Koreans into this.
the worst case scenario is that this all kind of, um, becomes one fire and not separate fires burning.

verdicts.note: A conceivable worst case, but the great powers have so far avoided fighting each other directly in either war.

assertions.quote: Iran retaliated by closing the straight of Hormuz and refused to reopen it without charging tolls. This destabilized the cost of oil

verdicts.note: Iran has no ICBM and no nuclear weapon; its threat is to US forces and partners in the region, not the US homeland.

US intelligence lists Iran among states developing delivery systems for the homeland but with no ICBM before 2035; elsewhere it says Iran has proven capable of lethal operations against Americans at home, so the threat is indirect rather than nil.

assertions.quote: they start rebuilding their nuclear program and reaccumulating uh a stockpile of nuclear material.

verdicts.note: IAEA reports show Iran complied until 2018-19, then enriched to 60% and grew its stockpile after the US withdrawal.

assertions.quote: will the United States invade Cuba next? >> I think so.

verdicts.note: Pressure, sanctions and an oil blockade are not an invasion, and nothing in the public record points to a planned invasion.

assertions.quote: I almost always look to, okay, where's the money going?

verdicts.note: A claim about motives behind threat assessments that no measurement settles.
